lead.headline: Colgate wins by 26 at Hofstra and holds the Patriot's top rating
lead.deck: The Raiders won on the road as underdogs, Boston University won at Harvard, and Lehigh rose to second in the rankings, then lost twice. The league went 10-11.
body: Colgate went to Hofstra on Friday as a 1.5-point underdog and won 75-49. Andrew Alekseyenko had 18 points, nine rebounds and five assists, and Sam Wright added 15. Earlier in the week the Raiders beat Penn State Behrend 87-55 behind 24 from Josh Ahayere. Colgate is 3-4, which looks ordinary, and 142nd in our model at plus-1.8 points per 100 possessions, which is the best in the league.

Boston University still owns the best record at 6-2. The Terriers lost 80-71 at home to Columbia as 1-point favorites despite 25 from Michelangelo Oberti and 24 points and nine rebounds from Kyrone Alexander. Then they won 81-72 at Harvard as 6-point underdogs, with 18 from Oberti, on a night Harvard's Tey Barbour scored 32.

American kept first place in the power rankings. The Eagles beat Towson 86-75 behind 22 from Dean Hogans and 21 points, six rebounds and seven assists from Madden Collins, then beat Radford 64-62 on Friday as 6.5-point favorites without covering. They are 5-2.

Lehigh jumped from sixth to second in Monday's rankings. The next night the Mountain Hawks lost 90-83 at home to Binghamton as 8.5-point favorites, and on Friday they lost 75-43 at UC Santa Barbara. Navy went the other way, from third to sixth, after a 69-66 loss at Rider as a 4.5-point favorite, then lost 75-59 at Fairfield on Friday.

The best finish belonged to Holy Cross. The Crusaders were 12-point underdogs at Dartmouth and won 67-65 on a three-pointer from Arius Alijosius with four seconds left. He finished with 15. It is the league's upset of the week and the Crusaders' only win so far. They are 1-6.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: Three games worth your week
body: **Vermont at Colgate, Saturday, 1 p.m. on FloSports.** Colgate is favored by 2.5, and our model makes it 4.7. The total is 142.5. Vermont arrives on a two-game skid after losing by 18 at home to Merrimack.

**UMass Lowell at American, Saturday, 4 p.m.** American is favored by 6.5. Lowell leads the America East power rankings and just won by 17 at Hampton. American didn't cover against Radford, and this line asks for more.
**American at Maryland, Wednesday, 7 p.m.** No line yet. The Patriot League's top-ranked team takes a Big Ten road trip four days after the Lowell game.

notes.headline: Cooper Kesler nearly beat Syracuse
notes.body: Lafayette lost 84-81 at Syracuse as 25-point underdogs. Kesler had 30 points and seven assists, and Shareef Jackson added 22 points and six assists. They had 39 between them in Friday's 82-54 win over Niagara.

notes.headline: Bucknell's 0-3 week
notes.body: The Bison lost 93-87 at home to Siena, 92-71 at Cornell and 89-86 at home to La Salle as 9.5-point favorites. Luca Soroa Schaller had 22 points and 10 assists against La Salle. Monday's rankings had already moved them from 10th to eighth.

notes.headline: Army's road win
notes.body: The Black Knights lost at Binghamton and at Air Force, where Kam Sanders scored 38, then won 79-61 at UTSA as 11.5-point underdogs.

notes.headline: Circle it: Vermont at Colgate
notes.body: Saturday, 1 p.m. ET on FloSports. Colgate is a 2.5-point favorite; our model makes it 4.7. The total is 142.5.
